# §7 Peer Benchmarking — Highlight Candidates

1. **Platform engagement in the top 5%** — Hubbardton Forge's 13,554 all-time platform logins are 109.9% above the peer median of 6,458, placing rep engagement in the top tier of similar accounts. [→ §peer]
2. **ARR investment exceeds double the peer median** — At $35,540 annually, platform investment is more than 2x the peer median of $16,980, reflecting strong commitment relative to similar accounts. [→ §peer]
3. **5 of 6 features adopted, ahead of most peers** — CPQ (40% peer adoption), Sales Portal (66%), and Portal Orders (66%) are all active; Kit Items is the only unadopted capability at 28% peer adoption. [→ §peer]
4. **Order activity at median despite top-tier engagement** — All-time order submissions (2,836) are just 3.2% above the peer median (2,748), while login engagement is 110% above — signaling an engagement-to-order conversion gap. [→ §peer]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Investigate the gap between top-tier engagement and median-level order activity — if rep training or workflow adjustments convert even a fraction of excess platform sessions into submitted orders, order volume could move above the 75th percentile [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §peer]
